ci-bot: pipeline main · FAILED — after merge 0a1b2c (PR #2345) :warning:
ci-bot: failing step: smoke-gpu (shard 3)
Alex: ugh, saw this. @sam are you oncall?

```
[2024-06-05 22:13:02] kv_prefetch.cc: alloc OOM, requested 512MB
Trace: allocator->evict() ...
```
Pri: that stack looks like the prefetch path. might be related to the kvcache patch in the merge (diff touched kv_prefetch.h)
Sam: can we rerun just smoke-gpu? I'll do minimal rerun.
Jess: FYI I rolled a quick job to increase node memory for the shard and triggered a rerun.
ci-bot: rerun started by sam (job id 98765)
Sam: rerun passed smoke-gpu but integration-serial still failing on trace logs.
Alex: okay, bisect time? the merge changed kvcache + prefetch ordering.
Pri: agree. can someone try reverting the prefetch reorder locally and run unit tests? i'll provision a small bisect runner.
Sam: starting bisect on main... will comment commit ids as i go. If anyone runs into it, add logs to the same CI job link: https://ci.redwood/98765
Alex: thanks. @infra can we temporarily add an autoscale fallback to avoid full node OOM while we triage? :pray:
infra: noted, bumping node memory + adding fallback. will post change id.
Sam: first bisect commit reverted (commit 0f3d2). running local reproduce.
Pri: if reproduce, let's fast-track a revert PR for the kvcache reorder and pair with a regression test.
Alex: agreed. i'll open a revert draft and ping owners.
Sam: leaving notes in the PR and will follow up when bisect finishes :thumbsup:
